task: Three heterogeneous blue UAVs defend two spatially separated assets against one red attacker that selects the less-covered route after realised blue deployment.

terminal_events.blue_success: existing legal attack/sensing/communication chain closes before strike
terminal_events.red_success: red reaches selected physical asset strike radius

gates.G0: reset/step interface, no future route label before branch, asset breach and defense success are mutually exclusive terminal events
gates.G1: transparent concentrated, split-defense and delayed-response controllers must exhibit non-degenerate terminal trade-offs
gates.G2: plain MAPPO must learn a non-saturated baseline before any method proposal
